description: Dependency-aware changes, explicit ownership and compatibility decisions
policy: Read project instructions and .workflow-kit/project.json before implementation.
Map affected packages, contracts, ownership and consumers before editing.
For cross-package changes record compatibility, migration, rollback and acceptance checks.
Reuse existing team conventions; do not invent approvers or mandate unavailable services.
Use independent review for material changes when available; disclose when unavailable.
Run scoped checks during iteration and project-required integration gates before handoff.
Load dependency slices, not the whole monorepo; persist short checkpoints to avoid rediscovery.
Never weaken correctness, data privacy or access controls because a time budget is short.
